aoi_context_note: aoi_context is Gate 2 experiment metadata (one AOI per context); it is not a source-defined settlement class

mvp_pooled_percentile.note: pooled over four hand-picked AOIs; not a national percentile

peer_percentile.reason: one AOI per aoi_context in the Gate 3 input: a peer cohort would be a single AOI and cannot be distinguished from the within-AOI percentile; no peer cohort fitted, no column emitted

excluded_from_all_transforms.reason: right-censored by the halo clip (search_truncated_by_extract); see validation_summary.distance_selection_bias
